description: Lane preset 'standard': stateless or easily rebuilt dependencies whose MR pipeline proves something (a build, a render, tests). Soak patch 1d / minor 3d / major 7d; patch, minor, digest and pin automerge; major is a manual merge. Releases without a timestamp (Harbor, GHCR) pass without a soak. Extend with `local>example-org/renovate:lane-standard(<file glob>)`; the argument is one matchFileNames glob, braces allowed.

packageRules.description: standard lane: label and timestamp behaviour
standard lane: automerge everything below major
standard lane: major is a manual merge
